title: Whirlpool Corporation v. Registrar of Trade Marks

content.caseIdentity: Whirlpool Corporation v. Registrar of Trade Marks, (1998) 8 SCC 1
content.holding: Alternative remedy does not bar Article 226 in four cases: breach of FRs, natural justice violation, lack of jurisdiction, or vires challenge.
content.relevance: The locus classicus on alternative remedy exceptions.
